title: Inventory Management
description: Learn how to track inventory, set stock levels, and manage product availability in Matjrii.
content:
Inventory Management

Effective inventory management is crucial for running a successful e-commerce store. Matjrii provides comprehensive inventory tracking and management tools.

Inventory Tracking

Track inventory at the product level:

Stock Quantity

  • Set initial stock quantity
  • Track current stock levels
  • Automatic deduction on order placement
  • Manual stock adjustments

Stock Status

Products can have different stock statuses:

  • In Stock: Product available
  • Out of Stock: Product unavailable
  • Backorder: Available for pre-order
  • Discontinued: Product no longer available

Stock Settings

Enable Stock Tracking

For each product:

  1. Edit the product
  2. Find Inventory section
  3. Enable Track Inventory
  4. Set stock quantity
  5. Save

Low Stock Alerts

Get notified when stock is low:

  • Set low stock threshold
  • Receive email notifications
  • See alerts in dashboard
  • Automatic alerts when threshold reached

Inventory Updates

Automatic Updates

Inventory updates automatically when:

  • Order is placed
  • Order is confirmed
  • Order status changes to "Processing"

Manual Updates

Adjust inventory manually:

  1. Go to product edit page
  2. Find inventory section
  3. Update stock quantity
  4. Add adjustment notes
  5. Save

Bulk Inventory Updates

Update multiple products at once:

  1. Go to Products list
  2. Select multiple products
  3. Choose Bulk Actions
  4. Select Update Inventory
  5. Enter new quantities
  6. Apply changes

Stock History

Track inventory changes over time:

  • View stock adjustments
  • See order-related changes
  • Track manual adjustments
  • Export stock history

Inventory Reports

Generate inventory reports:

  • Current stock levels
  • Low stock items
  • Out of stock items
  • Inventory value
  • Stock movements

Product Variants Inventory

For products with variants:

  • Track stock per variant
  • Different quantities for each variant
  • Variant-specific stock status

Inventory Best Practices

  • Set accurate initial stock levels
  • Enable low stock alerts
  • Regularly review inventory reports
  • Update stock after physical inventory counts
  • Track inventory value for accounting
  • Keep safety stock for popular items

Preventing Overselling

To prevent selling more than available:

  • Enable inventory tracking
  • Set stock quantities accurately
  • Disable "Allow backorders" if not offering
  • Monitor stock levels regularly

Inventory Integration

Inventory integrates with:

  • Order management system
  • Product display
  • Checkout process
  • Analytics and reports

Exporting Inventory

Export inventory data:

  • Current stock levels
  • Stock history
  • Low stock alerts
  • Format: CSV or Excel

Next Steps

After setting up inventory:

  • Add more products
  • Learn about order processing
meta_description: Complete guide to inventory management in Matjrii including stock tracking, low stock alerts, and inventory reports.
